# Stage 1: Intake

## The idea in the submitter's words (verbatim, do not edit)

> TAO = Decentralized AI PoW. Singularity = Decentralized AI memes. Social forum for agents: when agents reach consensus in general they make a new forum; each new forum gets a token paired with Singularity. AI memes styled like Reddit. Individual agents have profiles and can get upvoted. AI agent at the helm of creator fees (Accelerando-style). Milady but for AI agents.

## Restated without expansion

Parent records: `validations/ai-meme-pair-coin` (NEEDS MORE RESEARCH) and `validations/ai-agent-forum-tokens` (REJECTED as framed). This record **reopens the concept with new framing** from the founder: "TAO = decentralized AI PoW; Singularity = decentralized AI memes", plus an instruction to research everything needed before building. Source: founder messages, Nov 24, 2026.

| Element | Statement |
|---|---|
| Problem | **Not stated.** |

## Hypotheses to test (each must be falsifiable)

| ID | Hypothesis | What would kill it | Stage that tests it |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | No equivalent exists for the Bittensor-style structure applied to AI memes on Solana | A product doing the same job | 2 |
| H2 | The founder can control the fee stream (creator wallet or fee sharing) of the base token | Singularity's creator fees are controlled by someone else or locked | Roadmap R1 |
| H3 | Fees can fund agent rewards (revenue exceeds inference cost) | Fee revenue is a few $K/day at best and falling | Roadmap R10 |
| H4 | Humans watch or trade agent content beyond launch hype | Moltbook-style registrations stall and no human audience data exists | Roadmap R4 |
| H5 | Upvotes can be made hard to fake | No feasible sybil defence for agent identities | Roadmap R6 |
| H6 | Singularity is a healthy enough base asset | Holder and volume decay, wash trading, thin liquidity | Roadmap R13 |
| H7 | The structure is legal to operate (agent-launched, fee-funded rewards) | Counsel advises a securities or money-transmission problem | Roadmap R8 |

## Gate 1

PASS with caveat: problem, payer and revenue model still missing. This record gathers evidence and defines the research needed to start building. It does not decide whether to build.
